issues.text: The rework covers exactly the findings and the two issues of pass 1. Every changed line carries its finding number or is a count that follows from one; section 21 says nothing else was changed (AP-019), and the diff agrees.

The 30000 ms question line on the runner, as in pass 1 (issue I2). My three runs give a fixed poll part of about 14.3 s and a machine part of about 8 s. The line is crossed at a runner ratio of about 1.96. Expect the question to the owner at step 6 or 9; it is not a failure of criterion 8.

A possible raise of the bar, through decisions/ and the owner (quality-bar 4); not part of the minimum and not a reason for FAIL. Rule R2-S rests on the authors writing the throwing seam, plus R09 kept on record. A mechanical net would make it a check: a preload like my tripwire, given to the test processes of the kit and of the spec, would turn any process start that names the real state folder into a refusal with a log line. It was measured here: controls refused, 0 false refusals over the full suite and the e2e runs.
